allow_large: Owner approved fewer repeated lookups (2026-10-06): it touches command-line internals to look git facts up once per command, keeping every command, option and help text unchanged
done_when: Within one forge command the default branch, landed ref and git common folder are looked up once, and close reads the commits it needs with one git log call; behaviour is unchanged; a command test counts git calls in one close and shows each of those lookups happens once; the sdk_data test fixture finds the real uv even when a stub uv is on PATH; new and earlier-adopted client repos get it, with a command test for each

findings.body: With `log.showSignature=true` and a signed commit first in the batch, Git emits signature diagnostics before the NUL-delimited record. The parser at line 166 treats that preamble as a record and raises `ValueError`, so close crashes before review. The batch still lacks `--no-show-signature`. Disable signature output explicitly. This follows [Git's configuration contract](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-log#Documentation/git-log.txt-logshowSignature) and [its output ordering](https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.51.0/log-tree.c#L793-L829).
findings.title: [P2] Disable signature output in the machine-readable log

findings.body: Git log enables rename detection by default, unlike the replaced plumbing command. If a worker moves `app.py` to `plans/archived.py`, `--name-only` reports only the destination. The bookkeeping predicate at `src/forge/review.py:372` then skips this product-changing commit and copies an older commit's proof and functional check. Both paragraph readers are affected. Add `--no-renames` so classification sees the deleted product path as well. [Git documents this porcelain/plumbing difference](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-config#Documentation/git-config.txt-diffrenames).
findings.title: [P2] Disable rename detection when identifying bookkeeping commits

why: One forge close looks up the same git facts again and again (default branch 74 times, landed ref 24, git common folder 13) and reads each commit message with its own git calls; and a shared test fixture breaks when another test has put a stub uv on PATH
